text:
alex-support: Customer (acct_9XZ7) flagged a big mismatch: dashboard shows ~850k tokens for Mar, invoice INV-20260331-42 billed 1.2M tokens and bumped them into Business tier. They're upset. Any quick triage?

maria-cs: Which invoice/account exactly? I can ping customer with a status update.

alex-support: acct_9XZ7, invoice INV-20260331-42. Customer pasted their dashboard screenshot and says top endpoints are /v1/chat and /v1/embeddings. Said the spike happened on Mar 31 late evening.

billing-bot: Invoice processed: INV-20260331-42 total $12,450 (generated by billing-run v2026-03-31-1).

devon-billing: Pulling usage events now. Can you paste any sample request_ids or job ids the customer has? Also did they have any Dedicated or burst capacity?

alex-support: They sent a few sample lines, e.g. `req_20260331_23_58_az9` and `embed_job_20260331_2359_01`. They do async batch embeds via our queue. No dedicated pools.

sara-ops: I notice we rolled embed-queue v2 at 2026-03-31 23:50 UTC (release note: changed job id generation). Could be related.

devon-billing: Running reconciliation query: `SELECT SUM(tokens) FROM usage_events WHERE account_id='acct_9XZ7' AND billing_period='2026-03';` got 852,380. Invoice shows 1,199,512. There's ~347,132 extra tokens. Looking for duplicates.

devon-billing: Query to find duplicates: ```
SELECT request_id, COUNT(*) c, SUM(tokens) t
FROM usage_events
WHERE account_id='acct_9XZ7' AND ts >= '2026-03-31T23:45:00Z' AND ts <= '2026-04-01T00:10:00Z'
GROUP BY request_id
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1;
```

maria-cs: Running that returns many `embed_job_*` items with count=2. Sample: `embed_job_20260331_2359_01` counted twice, tokens 173,566 each.

devon-billing: Looks like duplicates from 23:58-00:05 window. That matches the embed-queue deploy. The billing pipeline dedup key is `event_id` — if producer switched to new job ids without setting idempotency key header, we can double ingest.

sara-ops: Confirmed: embed-queue v2 switched to `job_uid` field and we forgot to populate `event_id` for async worker ack. So ingestion created two events for retry path. Patch ready to emit `event_id`.

devon-billing: So root cause = missing dedupe key on async embed jobs during deploy -> duplicate usage ingestion -> invoice includes both -> tier bump.

alex-support: Customer will want immediate remediation. What's the mitigation?

devon-billing: Plan: 1) Add dedupe header in embed producer (deployed), 2) Run dedupe job for March usage to collapse duplicates (safe idempotent), 3) Re-run billing aggregation and emit credit memo + corrected invoice. Estimated ETA: 48 hours for corrected invoice.

maria-cs: Notifying customer: offered provisional credit while we reprocess. I'll propose a temporary adjustment so they don't get charged at Business tier.

ryan-legal: For credits: approved up to $15k without exec signoff. Escalate to finance for anything above.

finance-bot: Created ticket FIN-20260331-0901 to issue credit memo once corrected invoice is available.

alex-support: Repro steps saved in ticket: how to simulate duplicate ingest (run embed producer with and without event_id header), SQL used to identify duplicates, sample request_ids and log extracts. Assigning to eng-infra and billing.

devon-billing: Action items assigned: @sara-ops add event_id -> done; @eng-infra run dedupe script -> in progress; @billing-team reprocess billing -> queued. ETA 48h.

maria-cs: I'll keep customer updated and send temporary billing hold notice.

alex-support: Thanks everyone. I'll attach the invoice diff and a short summary for the customer-facing note. :thumbsup:
